methodology: official docs (GitBook) + live API probe + JS bundle analysis + web search

overview.mechanism: Matching Pool Mechanism (MPM) — zero-slippage by internally matching long/short positions
overview.v2_status: Strategic funding led by Consensys (Feb 2026), V2 = Modular Derivative Settlement Engine, no launch date yet

onboarding.model: Dual-path: traditional wallet connection OR social login via Particle Network

seamless_key.description: MYX proprietary delegated trading key — functions as an API key for programmatic use
seamless_key.how_it_works: Master wallet signs password message → seed generates new EOA key pair → private key encrypted with password and stored locally
seamless_key.gas_free: MYX relayer sponsors gas, fees deducted in USDC based on weekly average gas costs
seamless_key.non_custodial: Seamless Key carries no assets. All funds remain in Master wallet. USDC auth via ERC20 Permit.
seamless_key.security: Order nonce system prevents replay. Time-restricted validity. Session auto-destructs on expiration.

new_user_flow: 1. Create wallet via social login / phone / email (Particle Network)
2. Purchase USDC via credit card (built-in Buy function)

documented_rest.note: Only 2 public REST endpoints documented. No authenticated trading API via REST — all trading is on-chain via smart contracts or Seamless Key.

smart_contract_api.note: All trading is on-chain. No off-chain REST order API.

v2_upgrade.funding: Strategic round led by Consensys (Feb 2026), Consensys Mesh + Systemic Ventures as co-investors
v2_upgrade.architecture: Modular Derivative Settlement Engine — other platforms can build on top
features: Account Abstraction: EIP-4337 + EIP-7702 for gasless one-click trading
Chain Abstraction: collateral recognized across 20+ networks
Modular Settlement Layer: prevents liquidity fragmentation

api_contracts.note: Live, returns all perpetual pairs across BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Linea

app_csp.note: No vendor-specific CSP domains — wallet signals are in JS bundles instead

js_bundle_signals.particle_network: PARTICLE references — social login / embedded wallet provider
js_bundle_signals.biconomy: BICONOMY references — account abstraction / gasless relayer
js_bundle_signals.seamless: SEAMLESS — their proprietary Seamless Key system

github.note: Smart contracts only, no consumer SDK

assessment.web2_friendliness: High — Particle Network enables social login / phone / email, Seamless Key removes gas friction, built-in USDC purchase via credit card.
assessment.api_order_usability: Low for REST API (only 2 public market data endpoints). Trading is entirely on-chain via smart contracts or Seamless Key. No off-chain REST trading API.
key_friction_points: No off-chain trading API — all orders are on-chain smart contract calls
Seamless Key acts like an API key but is actually a delegated on-chain signer
V2 with full account abstraction not yet launched
Smart contract integration requires Solidity knowledge
unique_strengths: Particle Network social login with Seamless Key makes it very Web2-friendly for end users
V2 backed by Consensys, will become modular settlement engine
